sections.heading: Main objectives to establish alumni association are as follows -
sections.content:
1) To Mentor the students of the college for higher education, development of professional ethics and social awareness
2) To encourage the students of the college & members of the Association for research & development work in various fields of Engineering
3) To arrange and support in placement activities for the students
4) Promote the industry-institute interaction to bridge the gap between industry requirements and education offered and enhance students’ employability
5) To encourage and guide the students of the college on self employment to become entrepreneurs.
6) To provide Scholarships to deserving students and ex-students of the college – for the purpose of Education and Sport.
7) To encourage and support students of the college in sports, cultural and extra-curricular activities.
8) Facilitate and encourage alumni to contribute towards improvement of infrastructure for all round development of the current students of Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research.
Alumni Meet Report of 5 March 2018

sections.heading: Alma Connect Event Conducted during 2020-21
sections.content:
5.4.1 Alma Connect Criteria
Hope Everyone is doing well & Safe at this moment.
We, Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research, makes it easier than ever for our Alumni to help current Graduate Students of Engineering to find fulfilling career paths.
We Proud to announce that our APCOER Alumni Association took step forward to connect with all our prestigious Alumni networks across the Globe with “ Alma Connect” Programme.
Hopefully you are excited to virtual meet up with them shortly.
In this regard we are requesting your information to expand this APCOER Alma Connect Network.
Please kindly take a minute to fill this information form,
Link: https://tinyurl.com/APCOERALMACONNECT
